glossary.definition: (A) "Eligible individual with a disability" means an individual who has a physical or mental impairment that constitutes or results in a substantial impediment to employment and who requires vocational rehabilitation services to prepare for, secure, retain, advance in, or regain employment.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3304.11 to 3304.27 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (B) "Physical or mental impairment" means any physiological, mental, or psychological disorder.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3304.11 to 3304.27 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (C) "Substantial impediment to employment" means a physical or mental impairment that hinders an individual from preparing for, entering into, engaging in, advancing in, or retaining employment consistent with the individual's abilities and capabilities.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3304.11 to 3304.27 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (D) "Vocational rehabilitation services" has the same meaning as defined in section 361.5 of Title 34 of the Code of Federal Regulations, 34 C.F.R. 361.5 .
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3304.11 to 3304.27 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (E) "Establishment of a rehabilitation facility" means the expansion, remodeling, or alteration of an existing building that is necessary to adapt or to increase the effectiveness of that building for rehabilitation facility purposes, the acquisition of equipment for these purposes, and the initial staffing.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3304.11 to 3304.27 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (F) "Construction" means the construction of new buildings, acquisition of land or existing buildings and their expansion, remodeling, alteration and renovation, and the initial staffing and equipment of any new, newly acquired, expanded, remodeled, altered, or renovated buildings.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 3304.11 to 3304.27 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (G) "Maintenance" means monetary support provided to an individual for expenses such as food, shelter, and clothing that are in excess of the normal expenses of the individual and that are necessitated by the individual's participation in an assessment for determining eligibility and need for vocational rehabilitation services or the individual's receipt of vocational rehabilitation services under an individualized plan for employment.
